articles.title: Zelensky meets with Senator Graham
articles.summary: President Zelensky held a meeting in Kyiv with U.S. Senator Lindsey Graham to discuss strengthening sanctions against Russia and Ukraine's urgent air defense needs.

articles.title: Zelensky to attend Coalition of the Willing meeting in Paris
articles.summary: President Zelensky will participate in a Coalition of the Willing meeting in Paris on July 13 aimed at strengthening support for Ukraine and increasing pressure on Russia.

articles.title: Zelensky: Ukraine's peace proposals have support even within Putin's inner circle
articles.summary: President Zelensky stated in an evening address that Ukraine's peace proposals have support among international partners and within the Kremlin leader's inner circle.

articles.title: Zelensky calls Russia's fuel imports "historical joke"
articles.summary: President Zelensky stated that Ukraine has significantly disrupted Russia's fuel supply, forcing the country to import fuel despite traditionally exporting energy resources.

articles.title: Zelensky, Nawrocki agree to continue dialogue
articles.summary: President Zelensky met with Polish President Karol Nawrocki for over an hour on the sidelines of the NATO summit in Ankara, and both sides agreed to continue dialogue.
